title: Ginkgo Tree
price_note: not sold separately: included in Pro, or in the one-time Founders plan. price_usd is retired and stays null for paid assets — read `plan`.
preview_note: Full triangle count, but not the full asset: the hierarchy is joined into one anonymous mesh with every node and material name removed, and there is no .mjs program. The authored .glb and the module are what Pro delivers.

subscribe.includes: the .mjs program for every asset, structured GLBs with named pivots and rig, a per-account CDN you can hotlink from a shipped build, the whole catalog as one download, and the largest remix-baking budget
subscribe.note: once active, this endpoint returns download URLs and a /c/<token>/ CDN path. Anything downloaded while subscribed stays licensed forever.

export_note: vertex colours become NAMED MATERIALS on export, named after this asset's own colour knobs; a plain format conversion would arrive white, because only three.js reads our COLOR_0. Built on first request (about a second), cached after. available:false means this asset is not yours yet, so these URLs answer 403. Polyfork Pro ($149 a year for the whole catalogue) makes them fetchable; the preview GLB above needs nothing.
style: low-poly, flat-shaded vertex colors, no textures, single shared material, so any set of these merges to one draw call; shares palette and scale with its kit
origin: ground level (minY = 0): the model sits on y=0 as-is
animation: rigged parts are named groups with the pivot at the hinge/axle: obj.getObjectByName(part) then rotation[axis] (rotate, degrees) or position[axis] (slide, meters)
